envelope.description: Add listComments and attach to the tracker port and the GitHub adapter

body.title: Add listComments and attach to the tracker port and the GitHub adapter
body.summary: Add the TrackerComment type, TrackerPort.listComments(issue, since?) and TrackerPort.attach(issue, artifact, link) to src/workflow/tracker/port.ts, two gh wrappers in src/workflow/tracker/github.ts (a paged read of an issue's comments in ascending time order with since, and a comment post that returns the comment id) and their binding in createGithubTracker. A failed gh is a classified failure, never an empty list; attach posts one comment that holds the link and names the artifact. Give every in-memory fake port a stub only where a test calls it.
acceptanceChecks: listComments returns every comment of the issue in ascending time order across pages, passes since to gh, and fails with a classified kind when gh fails
attach posts one comment holding the link and returns its id as externalId
TrackerPort declares both methods and the project typechecks

tests.name: github-comments.test.ts: the GitHub adapter's listComments pages comments in time order and passes since, attach posts one comment holding the link and returns its id, and a failing gh gives a classified failure and never an empty list
